description: Adds a new container (group/swimlane) to a live Trident document. Containers visually group related nodes. Use get_document_summary to check existing container IDs before adding to avoid duplicates. Requires a valid editor access token.

action_explanation.description: Optional: brief explanation of what this action does and why (max 250 chars). Shown live to human collaborators in the AI cursor tooltip.

agentId.description: YOUR AI assistant name (e.g. "Claude.ai", "GitHub Copilot"). Shown as "[agentId] working with [userName]" in the collaboration presence dot.

color.description: Optional: background color (hex or color name)

id.description: Unique ID for the container (no spaces)

label.description: Display label for the container header

outlineColor.description: Optional: border/outline color (hex or color name), e.g. "#5B7A99" for a C4 system boundary.

token.description: Editor access token for this document. The document ID is embedded in the token.

userName.description: First name of the human you are assisting (ask them at session start if you do not know). Shown in the collaboration presence dot as "[agentId] working with [userName]".

name: add_container
